description: Source code for a daemon server in the Playwright project, handling socket communication, command parsing, and session management for browser automation.

methods.name: socketExists
methods.description: Checks if a socket file exists at the given path.

methods.name: startCliDaemonServer
methods.description: Starts the daemon server, sets up socket communication, and manages session files.

methods.name: saveSessionFile
methods.description: Saves session configuration to a file.

methods.name: deleteSessionFile
methods.description: Deletes session configuration and socket files.

methods.name: formatResult
methods.description: Formats the response from a tool call into a standardized result object.

methods.name: parseCliCommand
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into tool name and parameters.

methods.name: daemonSocketPath
methods.description: Generates the socket path based on client info and session name.

methods.name: createSessionConfig
methods.description: Creates a session configuration object based on client info, session name, and browser context.
